params.name: page
params.description: An ordinal number of the page to return with the results of a request (with the campaigns sent from the given number). Please note that page numbering starts at zero (`0`)

params.name: size
params.description: The number of the returned campaigns to show per page

params.name: accountPhone
params.description: The phone number the campaign was sent from

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of the campaigns you wish to retrieve:

  - **ALL:** Returns all campaign types

  - **IMMEDIATELY:** Returns immediate campaigns

  - **SCHEDULED:** Returns scheduled campaigns

  - **RECURRING:** Returns recurring campaigns

  - **RECURRING_SCHEDULED:** Returns recurring scheduled campaigns

params.name: state
params.description:
The current state of the campaigns you wish to retrieve:

  - **ERROR:** Returns campaigns that were not sent because of errors

  - **PAUSED:** Returns Paused campaigns on your account

  - **SENDING:** Returns sending campaigns

  - **COMPLETED:** Returns all successfully sent campaigns on your account

  - **MONITORING:** Returns all campaigns that includes "stop" words or malicious links

params.name: listNameOrId
params.description: The list name or list ID

params.name: startDateFrom
params.description: List campaigns starting from a certain date. The time is in [ISO 8601](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) format.

params.name: startDateTo
params.description: List campaigns up to a certain date. The time is in [ISO 8601](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) format.

Get all campaigns from the SimpleTexting system. You can filter campaigns by type using the `type` query parameter. By default, if `type` is not specified, only immediate campaigns are returned (scheduled and recurring campaigns will not be included).

**Example:** We request all `SENT` campaigns sent from the `8005551234` number to the list `My  First List`:

`https://api-app2.simpletexting.com/v2/api/campaigns?page=100&size=2&accountPhone=8005551234&state=SENT&listNameOrId=My First List&startD
